text:
Zoe: 3am snack poll — you wake up hungry, what's your go-to? trying to settle an argument with my partner. 

Mike: ice cream straight from the tub :ice_cream: 

Anya: popcorn + hot sauce (weirdly amazing) 

Ben: toasted bagel with cream cheese. crunchy edges > soft middle. 

Lucy: leftover pizza cold. no contest. :pizza: 

Sam: apple + peanut butter. healthy-ish. 

Karen: instant ramen, add an egg. 

Zoe: sounds like pizza vs dessert showdown. vote with emoji! :pizza: for pizza, :ice_cream: for dessert, :ramen: for ramen, :apple: for healthy 

Mike: :ice_cream: 

Anya: :popcorn: (not on emoji list but making a stand) 

Ben: :pizza: 

Lucy: :pizza: 

Sam: :apple: 

Karen: :ramen: 

snack-bot: quick tally — pizza 2, ice_cream 1, apple 1, ramen 1, popcorn 1 :bar_chart: 

Zoe: congrats popcorn. unexpected champion. 

Ben: unsolicited lifehack: microwave leftover pizza 30s, then sear in pan 60s. 

Lucy: @Ben trying that tonight. 

Anya: anyone keep a midnight snack stash at office? asking for... reasons. 

Sam: we do in common kitchen — granola bars and emergency chocolate. 

Zoe: thanks all. this thread settled nothing but gave me options. :heart:
